58:1: Allah has heard the word of the woman who disputes with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah; Allah hears the conversation of both of you.
58:2: Those among you who commit zihar against their women, they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who gave birth to them. And undoubtedly, they speak an evil word and a lie. And undoubtedly, Allah is very pardoning, very forgiving.
58:3: Those who commit zihar against their women, then retract what they said, it is required of them to free a slave before they touch one another. This is what you are admonished with. Allah is aware of what you do.
58:4: Whoever cannot find [one], it is required of him to fast for two consecutive months before they touch one another. Whoever is not able to do this, it is required of him to feed sixty poor persons. This is so that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits of Allah. And for the disbelievers, there is a painful punishment.
58:5: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be abased just as those before them were abased. And We have sent down clear verses. And for the disbelievers, there is a humiliating punishment.
58:6: On that day Allah will resurrect them all, then inform them of what they did; Allah has counted it, while they have forgotten it.
58:7: Did you not see that Allah knows everything that is in the heavens and on the earth? There is no secret talk of three persons but He is their fourth; nor of five, but He is their sixth; less than this or more, wherever they may be, He is with them. Then on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is the Knower of all things.
58:8: Did you not see those who were forbidden from secret talk, then they return to what they were forbidden from and talk secretly for sin, hostility, and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with a greeting with which Allah did not greet you, and they say within themselves: 'Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?' Hell is enough for them; they will enter it; what an evil destination.
58:9: O you who believe, when you converse privately, do not converse privately concerning sin, enmity, and disobedience to the Messenger; converse privately concerning goodness and taqwa, and fear Allah to Whom you will be gathered.
58:10: Secret whisperings are only from Satan that he may grieve those who believe, and he cannot harm them in anything except by the permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
58:11: O you who believe, when it is said to you in assemblies, 'Make room', make room so that Allah will give you room; and when it is said, 'Rise', rise so that Allah may raise those among you who believe and those who are given knowledge in ranks; and Allah is aware of what you do.
58:12: O you who believe! When you converse privately with the Messenger, present a charity before your private conversation. This is better for you and purer. If you cannot find [anything], indeed Allah is very forgiving, very merciful.
58:13: Were you afraid of giving charities before your private conversation? Since you did not do [it] and Allah granted you repentance, then perform the salah, give the zakat, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah is aware of what you do.
58:14: Did you not see those who took as allies a people with whom Allah is angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they knowingly swear falsely.
58:15: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, what evil things they are doing.
58:16: They made their oaths a shield and turned [others] away from the way of Allah; therefore, for them there is a humiliating punishment.
58:17: Their wealth and their children cannot avert anything from Allah away from them, and they are the companions of the Fire, they are abiders therein.
58:18: The day Allah resurrects them all, they will swear to Him as they swear to you, and they think that they stand upon something. Know well that indeed, they are the liars.
58:19: Satan overcame them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Beware! Indeed, the party of Satan, they are the losers.
58:20: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they are among the most abased.
58:21: Allah has written: 'I and My messengers will surely prevail.' Indeed, Allah is Strong, Almighty.
58:22: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their relatives. Those, (Allah) has written faith into their hearts and supported them with a spirit from Himself. He admits them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. Those are the hizb of Allah. Know well that the hizb of Allah, they are the successful ones.
